<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head><meta charset="utf-8"><title>Costumes</title>
<style>
  .seat { color: rgb(200, 0, 0); width: 120px; }
  .gone { display: none; }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<button class="seat" id="f7" style="background-color: gold">F7</button>
<script type="module">
  const seat = document.querySelector("#f7");
  console.log("style.color:", JSON.stringify(seat.style.color));
  console.log("style.backgroundColor:", seat.style.backgroundColor);

  const look = getComputedStyle(seat);
  console.log("computed color:", look.color);
  console.log("computed width:", look.width);
  console.log("computed background:", look.backgroundColor);

  seat.classList.add("gone");
  console.log("display now:", look.display);
</script>
</body>
</html>

cors.html.src:
<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head><meta charset="utf-8"><title>Letters to other sites</title></head>
<body>
<script type="module">
  async function ask(url) {
    try {
      const res = await fetch(url);
      console.log(url, "->", res.status, res.ok ? "ok" : "NOT ok");
    } catch (err) {
      console.log(url, "-> rejected:", err.name, err.message);
    }
  }
  await ask("/api/seats");                         // same site: theater.test
  await ask("/api/missing");                       // same site, but no such show
  await ask("http://boxoffice.test/seats");        // another site, no permission
  await ask("http://boxoffice.test/open-seats");   // another site that says "theater.test may read this"
</script>
</body>
</html>

</form>

    console.log("get('parking'):", data.get("parking"));

  });
</script>

validate.html.src:
<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head><meta charset="utf-8"><title>Checking the form</title></head>
<body>
<form id="book">
  <input name="name" required aria-label="Name">
  <input name="email" type="email" aria-label="Email">
  <input name="tickets" type="number" min="1" max="6" value="9" aria-label="Tickets">
  <button id="send">Book</button>
</form>
<script type="module">
  const form = document.querySelector("#book");
  for (const field of form.querySelectorAll("input")) {
    field.addEventListener("invalid", () => {
      console.log("invalid:", field.name, "|", field.validationMessage);
    });
  }
  form.addEventListener("submit", (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    console.log("submit event! checkValidity():", form.checkValidity());
  });
</script>
</body>
</html>
